pages.quiz:
MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

2. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 7
   C. 18
   D. 6

3. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

4. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 15.6
   D. 15.7

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

6. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 31
   D. 1

7. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 75
   C. 20
   D. 40

9. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 55
   B. 22
   C. 16
   D. 32

11. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

12. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
